map.解析会保留显式端口；默认端口(80/443)常省略。: Parsing keeps explicit ports; default ports (80/443) are usually omitted.
map.为什么解析不出查询参数？: Why can't query parameters be parsed?
map.常见原因：查询串里有未编码的 #（会被当作片段标识符，其后内容不属于查询）、多个: Common reasons: an unencoded # in the query string (treated as a fragment, after which content is no longer part of the query), multiple ? causing split errors, or an unencoded & in a parameter value. Also a relative URL must first be resolved against a base URL; parsing it directly lacks the protocol and host parts.
